neighbours.label: a token that sets aside one thing to widen or contrast the claim (not the only, rather than just, let alone, not just)
fire: Smoking was not the only cause of the illness in miners.
The links show on all the sites, rather than just the main one.
She had never seen a horse that tall, let alone ridden one.
Doctors aren't the only ones worried about the drug.
He can't boil an egg, let alone cook a meal.
The fix applies to every user, rather than a single account.
Pollution is not the only threat to the reef.
The rule covers all the staff, not just new hires.
quiet: Smoking was a common cause of the illness in miners.
The links show on all the sites and the main one.
She had seen a horse that tall and ridden it.
Doctors are worried about the drug.
He can boil an egg and cook a meal.
The fix applies to every user and a single account.
Pollution is a threat to the reef.
The rule covers all the staff and new hires.

notes: Card: ' let' x8, ' the' x5, ' purposes' x4, ' not' x3, ' than' x2, ' was'. Probes: ' let' 0.377, ' than' 0.315, ' the' in 'not the only' 0.299, ' not' 0.110; plain 0.006-0.007. Near misses drop the construction.
